01

What We Do

Tires are the whole business here, and they have been for a century. Whatever your vehicle needs to ride safe and straight, the work starts with a conversation and an honest look at your tires.

Bay 01

New Tires

Help choosing the right tires for your vehicle, your driving, and Detroit roads, fitted and finished in the shop.

Bay 02

Tire Repair

A flat or a slow leak does not always mean a new tire. We inspect the damage and repair what can be repaired safely.

Bay 03

Rotation & Balancing

Regular rotation and proper balancing help your tires wear evenly, last longer, and ride smooth.

Bay 04

Wheel Alignment

Pulling to one side or wearing unevenly? An alignment check puts your wheels back where they belong.

Bay 05

Seasonal Changeovers

Michigan weather turns fast. We swap and fit the right tires for the season ahead, winter or summer.

Bay 06

Pressure & Safety Checks

Tread depth, pressure, and a good look over all four corners, so small problems get caught before the road finds them.

02

Our Story

Sucher Tire Service opened its doors in 1922, when Detroit was building the cars the whole world wanted to drive. The city needed tires, and one family decided to be the ones Detroit could count on for them.

A century later, the name over the door has not changed, and neither has the family behind the counter. The business has passed from parent to child, again and again, until today it stands as a fourth generation family business, the oldest tire dealer in Detroit, and one of the city's truly historic businesses, still working in the same neighborhood where it started.

"Four generations. One shop. One promise: take care of Detroit drivers like neighbors, because they are."

Through every era of the automobile, the work stayed the same at its core. Fit the right tire. Do the job properly. Stand behind it. That simple standard is how a neighborhood tire shop outlives a century, and how it earns recognition like Metro Times Best Tire Store, ten straight years running.
